source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.rationale: The definition centers on a repeated local neighborhood multiset aggregation followed by a node-state update and a graph-level multiset readout; a compact graph schematic would make the stages and shared maps easier to follow.
concrete_labels_and_relations_to_draw_or: small graph with a center vertex v and neighbors u in N_G(v)
show h_u^(k-1) flowing into multiset aggregator A_k to produce a_v^k
combine h_v^(k-1) and a_v^k through U_k to produce h_v^k
show all final h_v^K entering the multiset readout R to produce z_G
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.classification: editorial candidate; no mathematical error is confirmed

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.rationale: The same sequence update supports two attention weight rules, and a diagram can distinguish softmax weighting from deterministic smallest-index argmax while showing the shared value aggregation and positionwise update.
concrete_labels_and_relations_to_draw_or: positions 1 through n including final eos
query position i sends scores a_(i,j) to all key positions j
soft path: softmax weights over j; hard path: one-hot weight at smallest maximizing j
weighted value vectors combine into b_(i,k,h), then F_k combines with current y_i^(k-1) into y_i^k
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.classification: editorial candidate; no mathematical error is confirmed

source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.rationale: The algorithm distinguishes partition cells, tags and volume weights, shared layer parameters, sampled states, and arbitrary query evaluation; a domain-to-mesh-to-layer flow could expose those correspondences at a glance.
concrete_labels_and_relations_to_draw_or: domain D partitioned into cells E_j with tags xi_j and weights omega_j=|E_j|
for each query x, local term W_t v_t,n(x) plus weighted kernel sum over tagged states
store layer values at tags for next layer while retaining evaluation at requested x
output projection Q on D-bar, or D-prime for the final differing-domain case
refinement changes E_j, xi_j, omega_j while learned parameters stay fixed
source_supported_missing_diagram_candida.classification: editorial candidate; no mathematical error is confirmed

diagram_review.reason: Reviewed existing diagrams: the bounded-domain degree map correctly depicts the induced relative-homology map and orientation classes; the group-convolution equivariance square matches the stated actions and commutation.
